sources.snippet: The 60-second version We fine-tune facebook/mms-tts-amh — an 83M-parameter VITS model that already speaks Amharic, badly — on a cleaned single-speaker Amharic corpus, using ylacombe/finetune-hf-vits. One run is about 20-25 minutes on a free-tier T4, and the upstream repo reports usable results from as few as 80-150 samples. That is why you get many cycles instead of one.

sources.snippet: Nahom - Your Project Handbook Over the next ten working days, six of us fine-tune an Amharic text-to-speech model. Text-to-speech means the computer reads written text out loud. The model is called facebook/mms-tts-amh; it already speaks Amharic badly, and we retrain it on better recordings so it speaks Amharic well.
